cause: The original tool-shell canonicalizes a bare /ui/tool.html into ?hostInstanceId=<uuid>, while driver newTab requires exact equality to the bare URL. The catalog did render successfully; the waiting predicate was incorrect for that entry URL.
minimalFix: Pass an explicitly generated hostInstanceId in the initial catalog URL as existing real native drivers do, retaining the exact URL predicate.
visualObservation: CJK fonts are absent from this Ubuntu runner screenshot, so Chinese glyphs render as empty squares despite correct DOM text. This did not cause the failure.
